channel.title: WPEG Salary Calculator Changelog
channel.description: New features, fixes, and improvements to the Winnipeg Salary Calculator, newest first.

item.title: v1.1.0: The big 2026 accuracy update
item.description:
The big 2026 accuracy update (November 9, 2026)

  • Corrected every tax figure to the official 2026 federal and Manitoba rates, including the new lowest federal tax rate, basic personal amount credits, the enhanced CPP2 tier, and updated EI premiums and ceilings.
  • Refreshed brand colours with stronger contrast, and added 22 selectable colour themes with full light and dark mode support.
  • Added an "On this page" jump menu on desktop so you can hop straight to any section.
  • Every rate now cites its official government source, linked directly to the CRA and Manitoba Finance pages.
  • Fixed the rent-to-income and perspective cards at $0 salary, and the Slurpee math in the deduction perspective.
  • Faster, cleaner, and more accessible under the hood: zero console errors and AA contrast throughout.

item.title: v1.0.0: Initial release
item.description:
Initial release (August 2025)

  • Winnipeg salary calculator with federal and Manitoba tax, CPP and EI estimates, dark mode, one-click sharing, and a healthy dose of Winnipeg fun facts.
